title: AMMO Mig AirViper new Airbrush Product Review Unboxing paint Air Viper
description:
In this video, I'll do the unboxing and review the new AMMO mig AirViper 0.2 airbrush, do some tests and give my final overall thoughts.
The AIRVIPER, a new airbrush that will allow modelers to perform fine detail and precision work with ease. The 0.2mm nozzle/needle combination makes it possible to spray extremely fine lines with complete control.

Link to shop: https://www.migjimenez.com/en/ammo-airbrushes/1807-airviper-airbrush-8432074086246.html
